title: S015 2.2.4.2 Authentication Using the AUTH Property
parent_path: S015 2.2.4.2 Authentication Using the AUTH Property

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The Client MUST set the Authentication Method as a property of a CONNECT packet by using the property identifier 21 (0x15).
statements.trigger: Client initiates connection with AUTH property
actions: Include Authentication Method property (identifier 0x15) in CONNECT packet

statements.subject: message
statements.description: This is followed by a UTF-8-encoded string containing the name of the Authentication Method, which MUST be set to "ace".
actions: Set Authentication Method string value to 'ace' in CONNECT packet

statements.subject: server
statements.description:
Based on the Authentication Data, the Broker MUST support both options below:
   *  proof of possession using a challenge from the TLS session
   *  proof of possession via a Broker-generated challenge/response
actions: Accept proof-of-possession via TLS session challenge
